name: SetLatch
description: Handle privacy requests (DSARs) for every client site from your AI assistant: see what is due, look requesters up in connected apps, update tasks and read the audit trail. Deletions stay a person's click in SetLatch.
author: SetLatch Pty Ltd

prompts.name: triage_requests
prompts.title: Triage privacy requests
prompts.description: See which privacy requests are open and due soonest, and what each one needs next.

arguments.name: site
arguments.description: Site name or slug. Leave empty for every site.

prompts.name: work_request
prompts.title: Work through a request
prompts.description: Open one request, check the connected apps for the requester, and list what is left to do.

arguments.name: request
arguments.description: The requester’s name or email, or the request id.

arguments.name: site
arguments.description: Site name or slug, if you know it.

prompts.name: log_request
prompts.title: Log a request received by email or phone
prompts.description: Record a privacy request that arrived outside the site’s form.

arguments.name: type
arguments.description: access, deletion, correction, opt-out or portability.

arguments.name: details
arguments.description: How and when it arrived, and anything they said.

prompts.name: data_map_review
prompts.title: Review a site’s data map
prompts.description: Check which systems hold personal data for a site and spot gaps.

resources.name: request-lifecycle
resources.title: How a privacy request moves through SetLatch
resources.description: Statuses, tasks, deadlines and when a request can be completed.

resources.name: connected-apps
resources.title: Look-ups in connected apps
resources.description: Which apps SetLatch connects to, what a look-up does, and how deletions are approved.

resources.name: assistant-limits
resources.title: What an AI assistant can and cannot do in SetLatch
resources.description: The boundaries of the SetLatch connector, for the assistant and the person using it.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: The sites you can work in, with your role on each (owner, staff or viewer) and where its data is stored.

tools.name: list_requests
tools.title: List privacy requests
tools.description: Privacy requests received by a site, newest first, with status and response deadline. Filter by status, or "open" for everything not yet completed or rejected.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

status.description: Only requests in this status; "open" = not completed or rejected.

tools.name: get_request
tools.title: Get a privacy request
tools.description: One request in full: the requester, deadline, one task per data map system (with its connections, past look up and deletion runs in connected apps, the by-hand steps and what the requester will be told), uncoveredSources (data map systems with no task yet), correspondence, files and its audit trail.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

request_id.description: The request id: the full id from list_requests (a unique start of it also works).

tools.name: create_request
tools.title: Log a privacy request
tools.description: Log a privacy request the site received another way (an email to the business, a phone call, a letter). Unless send_verification is false, SetLatch emails the requester a link to confirm it was them. Set received_at to when it actually arrived: deadlines run from then.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

type.description: access, delete, correct, optout (stop sale/sharing) or portability.

jurisdiction.description: The law it falls under: gdpr, uk, ccpa, us_state, au_app, ca_pipeda, ch_fadp, nz_privacy, other (us_state = the US state privacy laws other than California; other = anywhere not listed).

details.description: What they asked for, in their words.

received_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time it arrived, with offset. Defaults to now.

send_verification.description: Email the requester a verification link (default true). Set false when the team will confirm identity itself; they get a confirmation of receipt instead. Opt-outs never need verification and go live at once.

tools.name: update_request_status
tools.title: Change a request’s status
tools.description: Move a request along: verified (identity confirmed another way; starts the deadline and creates the tasks), in_progress, response_ready, completed (only when every task is done or nothing held) or rejected (outcome required).

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

request_id.description: The request id: the full id from list_requests (a unique start of it also works).

outcome.description: Why it was rejected, or a closing note.

tools.name: log_correspondence
tools.title: Log correspondence
tools.description: Record on the request a communication that happened outside SetLatch: a phone call, a letter, an email from a staff inbox. It is marked as logged (not sent by SetLatch) and audited. This does not contact anyone.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

request_id.description: The request id: the full id from list_requests (a unique start of it also works).

party.description: Who initiated it: the organisation (to the requester) or the requester.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time it happened, with offset. Defaults to now.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Update one system’s task on a request: mark it done, na (nothing held; note required) or back to todo, with an internal note, and/or set response_note, what the requester is told about that system in the response. Recording a task as done does not delete anything anywhere: on a deletion request, a person approves the deletion in connected apps from the SetLatch dashboard.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

request_id.description: The request id: the full id from list_requests (a unique start of it also works).

note.description: Internal: where it was found, what was done, or why nothing was held.

response_note.description: What the requester is told about this system. Empty string clears it.

tools.name: add_missing_tasks
tools.title: Add tasks for new systems
tools.description: Give a request a task for every data map system that holds personal data and has none yet (systems added after the request was verified: uncoveredSources in get_request). Adds tasks only; changes nothing else.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

request_id.description: The request id: the full id from list_requests (a unique start of it also works).

tools.name: list_connections
tools.title: List connected apps
tools.description: The apps a site has connected to SetLatch (Mailchimp, Stripe, Shopify, WooCommerce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Gmail, Resend, Cloudflare, webhooks), which data map system each serves, and whether it is working. No keys or settings.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

tools.name: look_up_requester
tools.title: Look up the requester in connected apps
tools.description: Ask the site’s connected apps whether they hold this request’s requester, through each vendor’s API, and record every answer on the request and in the audit trail. Covers every open task whose system has a connection, or just task_id. Returns per system: found, how many records, the vendor’s summary and reference; for access and portability requests the records are saved to the request as a file. Read-only at the vendor: it never deletes or changes anything there. The request must be verified and open; needs the owner or staff role.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

request_id.description: The request id: the full id from list_requests (a unique start of it also works).

task_id.description: Only this task’s system (it runs even if the task is already done). Omit for every open task with a connection.

annotations.title: Look up the requester in connected apps

tools.name: get_data_map
tools.title: Get the data map
tools.description: The systems a site keeps personal data in (CRM, email marketing, payments…), with notes and the names of the connected apps tied to each (SetLatch can look people up in those). Archived systems have archivedAt set.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

tools.name: add_data_map_system
tools.title: Add a system to the data map
tools.description: Add a system the site keeps data in. New verified requests get a task for every system that holds personal data.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

holds_pii.description: Whether it holds personal data (default true).

notes.description: Where to look and how, for whoever handles the task.

annotations.title: Add a system to the data map

tools.name: update_data_map_system
tools.title: Edit a data map system
tools.description: Rename or re-describe a system, or archive / restore it (archiving needs the owner role).

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).

tools.name: get_audit_trail
tools.title: Read the audit trail
tools.description: A site's tamper-evident audit trail, newest first, or one request's. Says whether the hash chain still verifies.

site.description: The site: its slug from list_sites (its id or exact name also work).
